<cite ref="Bava Metzia 40a:15">B. Mets. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>ושָׁקְלִין וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="U00497"><he>שׁוּפְטָנָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 60b:14">Ib. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>דקא שָׁקֵיל מיניה וכ׳</he> (not <he>שקלי</he>) for he takes from him &c., v. <cite ref="N00852"><he>נְכַת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 12b:11">Kidd. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>שְׁקַלְתָּהּ ואישתיקא</he> (not <he>שקלתא</he>) she accepted it and kept silence; <cite ref="Kiddushin 13a:4">ib. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>שְׁקַלְתֵּיה</he>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 13a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>אין שַׁקְלִי ודידי שקלי</he> yes, I received it, but it was mine I received.
<cite ref="Shevuot 32b:3">Shebu. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>הוה משתבענא ושְׁקִילְנָא</he> I should have been assigned an oath, and the money would have been decreed to me.

<cite ref="Berakhot 60a:10">Ber. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ בדקא וכ׳</he> a freshet carried away part of his field (Ms. F. <he>אישתקל וכ׳</he> a freshet was carried into his field); <cite ref="Bava Batra 41a:10">B. Bath. 41ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00158"><he>בִּדְקָא</he></cite>; a. fr.—Ber. l. c. <he>הוה שָׁקֵיל ואזיל בתריה וכ׳</he> took up (his cloak) and walked behind &c.—Part. pass. <he>שָׁקִיל</he>; f. <cite ref="U00123"><he>שְׁקִילָא</he></cite>; pl. <cite ref="U01865"><he>שְׁקִילִין</he></cite>, <he>שְׁקִילֵי</he>; <he>שְׁקִילָן</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 63b:2">Sabb. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>שקילי … שקילין וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>שקילין … ושקילן</he>), v. <cite ref="N00605"><he>נִיבָא</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 63b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>שקילא טיבותיך</he> (not <cite ref="U01835"><he>שקולא</he></cite>; better: <he>שְׁקוֹלִי וכ׳</he> take thy goodness), v. <cite ref="H00702"><he>חִיזְרָא</he> I</cite>; a. e.
